name: GB Auto (GB Corp)
source: GB Corp Annual Report 2025, consolidated statement of financial position and statement of cash flows (EGP thousand, stored absolute)
source_note: Read from the consolidated statement of cash flows in the GB Corp Annual Report 2025, EGP thousand stored absolute. Capital Expenditure is the printed payment for property, plant, equipment, projects under construction and intangible assets (FY2025 3,664,188 + 7,806; FY2024 3,171,932 + 25,520), stored negative as this dataset stores capex. Free Cash Flow is Operating Cash Flow plus Capital Expenditure. The three printed sections tie to the printed net change to within EGP 1 thousand (rounding in the report): -1,133,578 - 2,472,681 + 6,033,367 = 2,427,108 against the printed 2,427,107.
